title: Modifying the query for images: Part I

cues.en: So, we're pretty much finished with the file ingest.py and we want to turn our attention to query.py, okay?
cues.zh: ingest.py 大致完成了，接下來要處理 query.py。

cues.en: But before we do that, I left a line out, and it's not a big deal because it's a case that is not going to actually occur in the code that we're writing right now, but it's
cues.zh: 不過在這之前，我漏了一行。這不是大問題，因為目前的程式不會真的遇到這種情況，但

cues.en: always good to make sure things are handling every possible case.
cues.zh: 還是應該確保每一種可能情況都能處理。

cues.en: And what I left out is here, on line 139, I checked to see if there's not a description on line 138, so if that's empty, then I log a warning saying I'm going to fall back to
cues.zh: 我漏掉的是這裡，第 138 行檢查沒有 description 時，在第 139 行記錄警告，說要改用

cues.en: the file name, but I never actually do that, and it's a simple thing.
cues.zh: 檔名，但實際上並沒有執行這個替代處理。修正很簡單。

cues.en: All we have to say is description is equal to the format string, and I'll just say image file colon and whatever is in path.name, okay?
cues.zh: 只要把 description 設為格式化字串，內容是 Image file:，再接上 path.name。

cues.en: And that takes care of it.
cues.zh: 這樣就處理好了。

cues.en: Now, the other thing that I may as well fix up is you'll notice that here I have this function name, ingest image, I have it as an internal function, starting with an underscore, okay?
cues.zh: 另外順便修正一下，這個 _ingest_image 方法是內部方法，名稱以底線開頭。

cues.en: And that means up here, where I have ingest file, I probably should be consistent, okay?
cues.zh: 所以在上面呼叫 ingest 方法的地方，應該保持一致。

cues.en: So I'll just put the underscore there, so that should have an underscore.
cues.zh: 加上底線，這裡也應該有底線。

cues.en: Okay, now we're consistent.
cues.zh: 現在就一致了。

cues.en: So let's turn our attention to query.py and get started with this.
cues.zh: 接著開始處理 query.py。

cues.en: Now the first thing I have to do is modify my imports, okay?
cues.zh: 首先要修改匯入項目。

cues.en: Up here where I do pathlib, right underneath that, I'm going to need something else.
cues.zh: 在這裡的 pathlib 下面，需要另外一個功能。

cues.en: I'm going to need to be able to parse URLs, okay?
cues.zh: 我們必須能夠處理 URL。

cues.en: Because we're dealing with a web app.
cues.zh: 因為這是網頁應用程式。

cues.en: So from urllib.parse, the one I want in particular, I'm going to import quote, okay?
cues.zh: 從 urllib.parse 匯入 quote，這是這次需要的函式。

cues.en: So percent escape filenames in URLs.
cues.zh: 用來對 URL 裡的檔名進行百分比編碼。

cues.en: I need to have that, but I need to spell import right, import, okay?
cues.zh: 這個功能需要用到，不過得先把 import 拼對。

cues.en: So I'm going to import quote.
cues.zh: 所以匯入 quote。

cues.en: And the other thing we have is chat client and message.
cues.zh: 另外已經有 ChatClient 和 Message。

cues.en: I have everything I need from the LLM, so I think we're good for imports, okay?
cues.zh: LLM 所需的項目都有了，匯入部分應該沒問題。

cues.en: Now my goal here is not just to be able to ingest images.
cues.zh: 我的目標不只是能夠匯入圖片。

cues.en: I actually want to show them in the chat as well, okay?
cues.zh: 也希望在聊天裡顯示圖片。

cues.en: So we have this default system prompt.
cues.zh: 目前已經有預設系統提示。

cues.en: I'm going to have a second constant that tells the application how to show images in the chat.
cues.zh: 再新增一個常數，告訴應用程式如何在聊天中顯示圖片。

cues.en: And of course, it's marked down, right?
cues.zh: 當然是透過 Markdown。

cues.en: So we just need to tell it how to render images.
cues.zh: 所以只需要告訴模型如何呈現圖片。

cues.en: Now this is a fair bit of text, but let's get it out of the way.
cues.zh: 需要打一點文字，先把它完成。

cues.en: Image underscore instructions, and that's going to be equal to, and I'll write it the way I always do.
cues.zh: 建立 IMAGE_INSTRUCTIONS，照我平常的方式撰寫字串。

cues.en: So I'll say format your answers in plain markdown, okay?
cues.zh: 先寫：「請使用純 Markdown 格式回答。」

cues.en: And markdown has a capital M, even though the LLM doesn't care, let's put it in there, okay?
cues.zh: Markdown 的 M 要大寫，雖然 LLM 不在意，還是把它寫正確。

cues.en: And then on the next line, I'll say images like this, okay?
cues.zh: 下一行寫圖片的規則。

cues.en: An image is only available, and we'll give the condition, only available to you when
cues.zh: 「只有在以下情況，才表示你有可用的圖片：

cues.en: a context chunk above, and then a space, and then the next line, contains an explicit,
cues.zh: 上方的上下文區塊」，加上空格，下一行接「包含明確的

cues.en: and then we'll use, we'll put in what we put in there, image URL, like that, okay?
cues.zh: image URL」，使用我們在上下文中加入的相同標記。

cues.en: But no capital M. Image URL, colon, and then URL in pointy brackets like this, okay?
cues.zh: 先把這裡誤打的大寫 M 改掉。image URL 後面接冒號，再用角括號寫 <URL>。

cues.en: And we'll make sure that's available to it, and close the single quotes and just say line.
cues.zh: 確保有這個標記，關閉單引號後，再寫上 line，表示這一行。

cues.en: In that case, comma, and only, and then on the next line, in that case, just be as explicit
cues.zh: 「在這個情況，而且只有」，下一行接

cues.en: as you possibly can, you may, in all caps, embed the image inline using markdown image
cues.zh: 「在這個情況」，盡量說清楚，「你可以」，可以一詞用大寫強調，「使用 Markdown 圖片

cues.en: syntax, which I'll put on the next line, so I can put this all over here, syntax.
cues.zh: 語法將圖片嵌入文字中。」把 syntax 放到下一行，排版比較方便。

cues.en: And the image syntax for markdown is very simple.
cues.zh: Markdown 的圖片語法非常簡單。

cues.en: Image mark, square brackets, short alt text, and then outside of the square brackets, in parentheses, URL, okay? Comma.
cues.zh: 先寫驚嘆號，再用中括號放簡短的替代文字，中括號外的圓括號裡放 URL，最後加上逗號。

cues.en: Copying the URL verbatim from the, and then on the next line, image URL line.
cues.zh: 「必須逐字複製」，下一行接「image URL 那一行的網址」。

cues.en: If no image URL line is present in the context, and then on the next line, you must not emit
cues.zh: 「如果上下文裡沒有 image URL 這一行，」，下一行寫「就不得輸出

cues.en: any markdown image syntax, and then in parentheses, no, bang, dot, dot, dot, and then in parentheses,
cues.zh: 任何 Markdown 圖片語法」，括號中再明確說明，不得出現驚嘆號加中括號內容，再接圓括號

cues.en: dot, dot, dot, and then outside the parentheses, and no, and then on the next line, bang, dot, dot, dot, at all.
cues.zh: 網址的語法，下一行再強調完全不要產生驚嘆號開頭的圖片標記。

cues.en: Just be really clear, okay?
cues.zh: 盡可能說清楚。

cues.en: And in closing parentheses, just be really clear, okay?
cues.zh: 再關閉括號，確保表達清楚。

cues.en: Just answer in words.
cues.zh: 「只使用文字回答。」

cues.en: The user can ask for a URL, because we can.
cues.zh: 使用者可能要求一個 URL，這當然可以，

cues.en: We can ask for whatever we want.
cues.zh: 使用者可以提出任何要求。

cues.en: That doesn't exist.
cues.zh: 但那個 URL 可能根本不存在。

cues.en: In that case, say so plainly, okay?
cues.zh: 遇到這種情況就明確說明。

cues.en: Never invent a URL.
cues.zh: 「絕對不要捏造 URL。」

cues.en: And the last line, and never guess one from a file name, okay?
cues.zh: 最後一行：「也絕對不要根據檔名猜測 URL。」

cues.en: Now, that was a lot of typing for this lecture, but so far, we've got our imports done properly, and we've got a prompt we can use to format images in Markdown.
cues.zh: 這堂課打了不少字，但目前已完成正確的匯入，以及用來指示模型以 Markdown 格式呈現圖片的提示。

cues.en: And we're also making it clear to the LLM that we want the responses in plain Markdown, which most of them do by default, but it never hurts to be explicit, okay?
cues.zh: 也明確告訴 LLM，回應要使用純 Markdown。雖然大部分模型預設會這麼做，但把要求寫清楚沒有壞處。

cues.en: So that's enough for this time around. Let's move on.
cues.zh: 這堂課先到這裡，繼續吧。
